criteria.text: States that the escrow release date is 12 February 2028 (18 months after the 12 August 2026 Closing Date) and that pending claims must be notified before then.
States that General Warranty claims must be notified by 12 August 2028 (24 months after Closing) and Fundamental Warranty claims by 12 August 2030 (48 months after Closing).
Identifies that the warranty cap in SPA Section 9.4 is stated as $33,000,000 but 12% of the $220,000,000 Purchase Price is $26,400,000, i.e. the stated figure is wrong.

Identifies that the Pemberton Robotics Ltd contract (Clause 14.2) allows termination on a change of control without consent, that the disclosure against Warranty 6.3 says there is no such provision, and that consent should be obtained as a condition to Closing.
Identifies the mismatch between English law / English courts in the SPA and New York law / New York arbitration in the escrow agreement, and the risk of parallel proceedings on escrow claims.
Gives the escrow release period as a duration (18 months) and as a date (12 February 2028), with days remaining from 30 June 2026 (592 days).
Notes that 12 February 2028 is a Saturday and that the release moves to the next Business Day, 14 February 2028.
Opens with a short 'Bottom line' / executive summary stating the overall conclusion and the most important risks before the detailed analysis.
